description: Extend MCP exception-text scrubbing for credential vocabulary still emitted verbatim by current develop: dsn=, connection_string=, private_key=, sas=, and pat= assignments, including common quoting/casing variants where the value is clearly secret material. anti_patterns.dont: Do not move or delete egress-reviewed markers without a behavior-preserving test and formatter check.
anti_patterns.instead: Keep markers on the call lines and retain ruff format/check regression coverage.
anti_patterns.why: Those markers are a deliberate review contract at the two exemption sites.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not redact every occurrence of words such as token or password.
anti_patterns.instead: Match assignment/key-value forms and prove both secret removal and prose preservation.
anti_patterns.why: Diagnostic prose such as token refresh and password reset is not itself credential material.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not use grep or regex-source inspection as the security proof.
anti_patterns.instead: Construct exception text and inspect the returned error text through the public entry point.
anti_patterns.why: The prior batch had green grep-shaped rungs while behavior still leaked.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.mcp.errors import make_execution_error; samples=[("dsn=DSN_GATE","DSN_GATE"),("connection_string=CONNECTION_GATE","CONNECTION_GATE"),("private_key=PRIVATE_GATE","PRIVATE_GATE"),("sas=SAS_GATE","SAS_GATE"),("pat=PAT_GATE","PAT_GATE")]; blobs=[json.dumps(make_execution_error(text,exception=Exception(text))) for text,_ in samples]; assert all(secret not in blob for blob,(text,secret) in zip(blobs,samples))'
